fixed.what: Address CRUD (add/update/delete/setDefault) no longer closes over stale `user`: added userRef mirroring latest user for guards, and each success path uses functional setUser(prev => ...) deriving addresses from prev state; server response (data.addresses full list or data.address) replaces local state as source of truth, with dedupe-by-id on add.

Guest-cart merge rewritten as sequential loop with per-item try/catch: one failed push no longer drops remaining guest items; mergeAborted ref flips on logout (isLoggedIn false) and is checked before each push and before final server fetch; on partial failure failed items are kept in the local (guest) cart and a warning toast is surfaced.

Added role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-label, tabIndex={-1} + dialogRef on modal card; useEffect adds document-level keydown capture handler for Escape-to-close and Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap cycling within focusable elements, with initial focus on the dialog. No new deps.
